card.name: Packings of 6-sets on 12 points with no repeated 5-subset (the Witt design S(5,6,12))

task.name: Packings of 6-sets on 12 points with no repeated 5-subset (the Witt design S(5,6,12))
task.description: construct() -> list of distinct 6-subsets of 0..11 such that no 5-subset lies in two blocks. Maximize the number of blocks; the optimum 132 is attained exactly by the Steiner system S(5,6,12). Each block covers six 5-subsets of the 792, so at most 132 blocks fit; 132 is attained only by the Witt design S(5,6,12).
